purpose: Remove residual copy-paste gameplay from the seven Arsenal capability tracks after Qualification was already converted to possession/readiness. Fieldwork and Munitions become family-specific demonstrations of use while preserving the frozen 31-quest runtime candidate until its deferred physical gate is explicitly activated.

sidearms.qualification: Possess one approved sidearm; keep it.

fieldwork.intent: Use a sidearm as a deliberate close-range or contingency weapon rather than farming generic eliminations.

munitions.intent: Demonstrate controlled sidearm employment before finite L191 access.

smg-pdw.qualification: Possess one approved SMG or PDW; keep it.

fieldwork.intent: Prove short-range volume-of-fire capability in a bounded close-quarters context.

munitions.intent: Complete one successful sustained-contact operation before finite .45 ACP AP access.

shotguns.qualification: Possess one approved shotgun; keep it.

fieldwork.intent: Validate decisive short-range employment with a shotgun, not a generic higher kill count.

munitions.intent: Demonstrate deliberate accurate shotgun use before finite AP-20 access.

assault-rifles.qualification: Possess one approved assault rifle; keep it.

fieldwork.intent: Prove general-purpose rifle employment across a normal patrol engagement envelope.

munitions.intent: Complete a bounded service-rifle operation before finite high-performance ammunition access.

marksman-battle-rifles.qualification: Possess one approved marksman or battle rifle; keep it.

fieldwork.intent: Prove controlled medium-range target discrimination with a marksman or battle rifle.

munitions.intent: Demonstrate disciplined medium-range capability before finite specialist ammunition access.

precision-rifles.qualification: Possess one approved precision rifle; keep it.

fieldwork.intent: Prove actual long-range precision at one meaningful threshold rather than a 20/30/40/... distance staircase.

munitions.intent: Complete a low-count precision validation before finite specialist rifle ammunition access.

special-weapons.qualification: Possess one approved special-weapon platform; keep it.

fieldwork.intent: Demonstrate one bounded mission-relevant use of the approved special platform without turning rare systems into a grind track.

munitions.intent: Validate specialist use for a representative sample reward only; no permanent heavy, explosive or special-ammunition storefront offer.
